title: TDK service configuration
description: Configuration for a TDK service in service.json. TDK uses these fields to discover and run services during local development.

$schema.description: URL of the JSON Schema used by editors to provide completion and validation.

appName.description: Unique name of this service, typically matching its resource directory name.

appType.description: TDK service type. Legacy service.json files may use the type property instead.

type.description: Legacy alias for appType. Prefer appType in new service.json files.

stack.description: Stack or group this service belongs to.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the TDK service manifest format.

port.description: Host port used to access this service during local development.

replicas.description: Number of local service instances to run.

runtime.description: Runtime used to run this service.

name.description: Legacy service name. Prefer appName in new service.json files.

dependencies.description: Legacy build dependencies field. Prefer dependsOn for service startup dependencies.

items.description: Name of a legacy build dependency.

framework.description: Framework provider id selected by the CLI provider registry for this service.

language.description: Backend language provider id selected by the CLI provider registry for this service.

build.description: Optional build configuration used when creating this service's container image.

dev.description: Optional local development command and file-watch configuration.

featuresEnabled.description: Known TDK resource features enabled for this service.

dependsOn.description: Stack or service names that must start before this service.

enabled.description: Whether this service is enabled in its project configuration.

basePath.description: URL path prefix used to route requests to this service.

backendName.description: Name of the backend associated with this service, when applicable.

apiPath.description: API path exposed by this service, when applicable.

healthCheckPath.description: HTTP path probed to determine whether the service is healthy. Defaults to /health.

smoke.description: Optional post-start checks sent through this service's public proxy URL.

via.description: Route used to run the checks. Currently only the public proxy is supported.

timeoutSeconds.description: Maximum time to wait for the checks to pass.

steps.description: Non-empty ordered list of HTTP checks to run.

items.description: One HTTP request and its expected response.

name.description: Optional display name for this check.

path.description: Path appended to this service's public proxy URL.

expect.description: Expected HTTP status code, from 100 through 599.

bodyContains.description: Optional text that must occur in the response body.

save.description: Names mapped to JSONPath expressions whose values are saved for later steps.

additionalProperties.description: JSONPath expression for a value to save.

traefik.description: Optional Traefik routing and load-balancer health-check overrides.

host.description: Custom hostname used to route requests to this service.

pathPrefix.description: URL path prefix used to route requests to this service.

healthCheck.description: Path Traefik uses to probe this service's health.

sablier.description: Optional on-demand scaling configuration for this service.

group.description: Name of the group of services that scale together.

sessionDuration.description: How long the service stays active after its last request.

deferStart.description: Whether to defer starting this service until its first request. Requires enable to be true.

dockerfile.description: Optional Dockerfile path relative to the service directory.

image.description: Optional Docker image name to use instead of building an image.

exposeViaProxy.description: Whether a bring-your-own service should receive a Traefik route.

restart.description: Docker Compose restart policy for this service.
